# FPL Points Calculator

> Live Fantasy Premier League mini-league leaderboard with HTML, JSON, and CSV outputs.

## Primary URL
- https://queazified.github.io/fpl-points-calculator/fpl.php

## Purpose
FPL Points Calculator provides near real-time mini-league standings using official Fantasy Premier League API data and lightweight server-side caching.

## Key Pages
- /fpl.php — homepage and interactive leaderboard
- /404.php — custom not found page

## Data Sources
- https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/bootstrap-static/
- https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/leagues-classic/{league_id}/standings/
- https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/entry/{entry_id}/
